examples.text_en: The labile state of the market was hard to take.
examples.text_zh: 市场易变的状态让人难以承受。

examples.text_en: His labored words made the whole talk feel long.
examples.text_zh: 他吃力的话语让整场谈话显得很漫长。

examples.text_en: The labored work took them many hard hours.
examples.text_zh: 这项费力的工作花了他们许多个小时。

examples.text_en: The laborer worked hard under the hot sun all day.
examples.text_zh: 这个体力劳动者在烈日下辛苦工作了一整天。

examples.text_en: A young laborer moved the boxes to the room.
examples.text_zh: 一个年轻的工人把箱子搬到了房间里。

examples.text_en: It was a laborious job that took many weeks.
examples.text_zh: 这是一项费力的工作，花了好几个星期。

examples.text_en: She made a laborious try to change the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 她费了很大力气想改变整个计划。

examples.text_en: He walked laboriously up the long hard road.
examples.text_zh: 他吃力地沿着那条漫长难行的路往上走。

examples.text_en: She wrote the words laboriously on the small page.
examples.text_zh: 她在小纸上一笔一画地费力写下这些字。

examples.text_en: The labourer had worked on the land for years.
examples.text_zh: 这个劳工在这片土地上工作了许多年。

examples.text_en: They paid the labourer a little money each week.
examples.text_zh: 他们每周付给这个劳工一点钱。

examples.text_en: The old building was a labyrinth of dark rooms.
examples.text_zh: 这栋旧楼像一座由暗房间组成的迷宫。

examples.text_en: He got lost in the labyrinth of the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他在小镇的迷宫中迷了路。

examples.text_en: The hard thing can lacerate the hand in a second.
examples.text_zh: 这个坚硬的东西一瞬间就能划破手。

examples.text_en: His hard words seemed to lacerate her heart.
examples.text_zh: 他那些无情的话仿佛撕裂了她的心。

examples.text_en: The laceration on his arm was long and deep.
examples.text_zh: 他手臂上的伤口又长又深。

examples.text_en: They cleaned the laceration and put a cover on it.
examples.text_zh: 他们清理了伤口，并在上面敷了东西。

examples.text_en: The lachrymose child felt bad at every little thing.
examples.text_zh: 这个爱哭的孩子为一点小事就难过。

examples.text_en: His lachrymose story made the whole group feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那悲哀的故事让整个团队都很难受。

examples.text_en: His lackadaisical way made the whole team feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他懒洋洋的态度让整个团队都不舒服。

examples.text_en: She was lackadaisical about the work all week.
examples.text_zh: 她整个星期对工作都提不起劲。

examples.text_en: The lackey did everything the old man asked.
examples.text_zh: 这个随从对老人的要求言听计从。

examples.text_en: They saw him as a lackey with no mind of his own.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他看作一个没有主见的马屁精。

examples.text_en: His lackluster answer made the whole meeting feel long.
examples.text_zh: 他平淡无奇的回答让整个会议显得漫长。

examples.text_en: The lackluster light gave the room a dark look.
examples.text_zh: 暗淡无光的灯让房间看上去很黑。

examples.text_en: His laconic answer said more than a long talk.
examples.text_zh: 他简洁的回答胜过一番长篇大论。

examples.text_en: She had a laconic style that everyone respected.
examples.text_zh: 她有自己简洁的风格，人人都很敬重。

examples.text_en: The lactic food was light and easy to take.
examples.text_zh: 这种乳制食品清淡，容易接受。

examples.text_en: They studied the lactic part of the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了这种食物中来自乳汁的部分。

examples.text_en: The old car was laden with boxes and things.
examples.text_zh: 这辆旧车装满了箱子和杂物。

examples.text_en: He felt laden with care after the long year.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的一年过后，他感到心事重重。

examples.text_en: The laggard was soon far behind the rest.
examples.text_zh: 这个落后者很快就远远落在了别人后面。

examples.text_en: They did not want to be seen as a laggard.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想被人看作落伍者。

examples.text_en: The water in the small lagoon was clear and green.
examples.text_zh: 这个小泻湖里的水清澈碧绿。

examples.text_en: They found a safe lagoon near the open sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们在开阔的大海附近找到了一个安全的泻湖。

examples.text_en: They found a lair deep in the dark night.
examples.text_zh: 他们在黑夜深处发现了一个兽窝。

examples.text_en: The lair was among the high dark walls.
examples.text_zh: 这个兽窝藏在又高又暗的墙壁之间。
